response.sql: WITH acct AS (SELECT account_id, AVG(CASE type WHEN 'PRIJEM' THEN amount WHEN 'VYDAJ' THEN -amount END) AS avg_amt FROM trans WHERE type IN ('PRIJEM','VYDAJ') GROUP BY account_id), m AS (SELECT AVG(avg_amt) AS mean_avg FROM acct) SELECT a.account_id, a.avg_amt AS average_amount, a.avg_amt - m.mean_avg AS diff_above_mean FROM acct a CROSS JOIN m WHERE a.avg_amt > m.mean_avg ORDER BY diff_above_mean DESC LIMIT 10
